name: Maryland Online Data Privacy Act
description: Maryland's comprehensive consumer privacy law, notable for stricter data-minimization requirements than most other state laws (limits collection to what's "reasonably necessary and proportionate" rather than just requiring disclosure).
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by State of Maryland (maryland.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within State of Maryland (maryland.gov).
